title: acer opalus f. keckianum
intro: Acer opalus f. keckianum, commonly known as the Keck's maple, is a subspecies of the Acer opalus plant, a type of deciduous maple tree native to the Mediterranean region. The Keck's maple is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potential antimicrobial agent, suggesting its potential use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the Keck's maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
